svg.text: LAUNCH FILM · STORYBOARD V2 · SAAS LAUNCH CUT

g.text: A finished script, or one line about the idea. Both work.
Why the Panama Canal ran short of water
First video free · up to ten minutes
V2 · SHOT 05 — MACRO: ONE LINE IN

svg.text: Macro on the prompt: "Why the Panama Canal ran short of water" being typed, the green
caret, the Send to brew button in sharp focus while the rest of the UI melts into
Rack focus from caret to button. Cursor glides in and clicks; button compresses 2px
and the green spills outward as light.
Close-mic keyboard, one tick per character; tactile click.
The button's light streaks right into the pipeline.

g.text: V2 · SHOT 06 — TRACKING SHOT: THE PIPELINE

svg.text: The seven pipeline stages from the site, scaled up into a physical track. Camera
tracks sideways along it; done stages dim, EDIT burns green. Beneath each stage a tiny
Lateral dolly R→L at constant speed, 3s. Motion blur on the passing pills. Each stage
"…we research it, write it, voice it, and cut it."
A rising arpeggio, one note per stage.
Split into a 2×2 of macro shots.

g.text: Every ship that crosses uses 50 million
EDIT · CLIPS SNAP TO THE SCRIPT

svg.text: Four macro tiles on the beat: a verified fact (50,000,000 gallons), a highlighted
script line, the voice waveform, timeline clips snapping together.
Tiles cut in clockwise on four beats, then all four push in 4% together. Thin green
Four percussive UI clicks on the beats.
Tiles collapse into the review player.

g.text: V2 · SHOT 08 — REVIEW: A PERSON WATCHES

svg.text: The review screen in hero light: Rose Freedman's 1911 photograph in the player, the
15-point checklist at 15/15, and the reviewer card "Watched by Maya K." The viewfinder
Music drops to a single pad. Slow 2s push in. Brackets snap with overshoot. Checklist
"Then a person watches all of it."
Near silence, then soft ticks and one warm confirmation tone.
